name: elagoht/sitemap
description: A collage plugin that serves /sitemap.xml from the pages the application registered.
setup: A sitemap lists absolute URLs, so it needs the site's origin: set `BASE_URL` in a project `collage new` made (it becomes `Config.BaseURL`), or register an origin resolver such as `elagoht/tenant`. Without one the application does not start.

config.description: A collage plugin that serves /sitemap.xml from the pages the application registered.

exclude.description: Exclude names pages to leave out: a thank-you page, a search page, anything a search engine has no reason to index.

maxURLs.description: MaxURLs lowers the number of URLs per file below MaxURLs. Zero is MaxURLs, a negative number an error, and one above MaxURLs is MaxURLs.

path.description: Path is where the sitemap is served. Default "/sitemap.xml". The numbered files of an index are served under it without the extension: "/sitemap/1.xml", "/sitemap/2.xml".
